name: 4D Convex Polytope Line Segment Culling
aliases: 4D Convex Polytope Line Segment Culling (Camera Outside)
definition: A culling algorithm for determining which parts of a line segment (parameterized t in [0,1]) are visible when the camera is outside a 4D convex polytope. It uses an array of hyperplanes P to clip the segment, maintaining a safe interval (a, b) that represents the unoccluded portion.
summary: This algorithm culls 4D wireframe segments occluded by convex polytopes by constructing an occlusion cone from front-facing hyperplanes, distinguishing itself by handling 4D geometric topology rather than using coordinate-aligned simplifications.
